mcqs.question: Which Union Territory became the first to achieve 100% literacy under the ULLAS programme in October 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Lakshadweep became the first Union Territory to achieve 100% literacy under ULLAS, as declared on 11 October 2026. Kavaratti is the capital of Lakshadweep, while ULLAS is the programme also known as the New India Literacy Programme.
